title: A retained bind that fails as its head's admission window runs out parks a bind retry that promises an automatic retry until the next tick ends it
outcome:
w-ac230a24d0d8's window-spent check runs first at the generic admission park (engram_queued_admission.rs) only. A retained bind failure parks through src/api.rs:366 and park_engram_bind_retry (engram_bind_retry.rs:371-405). That path still creates a bind_retry unconditionally and shows "waiting for durable automatic retry", even when the bind attempt has used up the head's 240 s window. The next retry tick ends it in the exhaustion hold, but until then the card promises a retry that will not happen.
Fix: apply engram_admission_window_spent and end_engram_spent_admission_window before the bind park schedules. Add a test that expires the window during the bind attempt and inspects the park before another tick.
acceptance: A retained bind that fails as its head's admission window runs out parks a bind retry that promises an automatic retry until the next tick ends it is done
